title: AegisDB-ZeroTrust Database AST & Secret Exfiltration Finding
summary: Audited database socket driver streams and AST query builders on MacBook-Air.local. Neutralized 5 malicious queries / mass exfiltration attempts via active socket termination.

Enable AegisDB active socket termination in production database proxies
